source-o.table-s: 6.3 Recommended Operating Conditions: VIN input voltage range 2.7-12 V (ZHCSDP8D, spec tables in English)

ripple_source-o.table-s: 8.2.2.6 Input Capacitor Selection: 'recommended to have enough input capacitance to make the input voltage ripple less than 100mV' (design recommendation for the power-stage input, no band stated)

component-o.description-s: 10A fully-integrated synchronous boost converter, 2.7-12V in, adjustable output (configured 7.0V) [PFM SKU: MODE (pin 13) left open: PFM at light load. Best light-load efficiency; the switching frequency varies at light load (audible noise possible).]

cfgpins-ao.2c: EN: logic high turns the converter on. Tied to VIN for always-on (Figure 8-1 shows an ON/OFF switch); a GPIO may drive it instead.

cfgpins-ao.17c: Feedback divider (Figure 8-1, 3.3 V to 9 V/3 A): R1 360 kΩ VOUT to FB, R2 56 kΩ FB to ground (the datasheet's standard low-side value); VOUT = VREF x (1 + R1/R2), VREF 1.204 V (PWM) / 1.212 V (PFM). The design re-values it to the architect's set-point.

cfgpins-ao.3c: Switching frequency set by a resistor from FSW to SW (not to ground): 255 kΩ gives the typical application's 600 kHz.

cfgpins-ao.19c: Peak switch current limit: resistor ILIM to AGND; 100 kΩ gives about 11.9 A (datasheet, Setting Peak Current Limit).

cfgpins-ao.18c: Loop compensation R5 + C5 from COMP to AGND, computed with the datasheet equations for Figure 8-1 (3.3 V to 9 V/3 A, L 1.2 µH, CO 67 µF, fC 10 kHz below fRHPZ/5): R5 = 2π·VOUT·Rsense·fC·CO / ((1-D)·VREF·GEA) = 36.5 kΩ (Rsense 0.08 Ω, GEA 190 µA/V); C5 = RO·CO / (2·R5) = 2.7 nF. C8 = RESR·CO / R5 is about 4 pF with ceramic output capacitors: not fitted.

cfgpins-ao.13c: MODE left open (not connected): PFM at light load, per the datasheet (floating = PFM). Intentionally unstrapped.

sw_not_stated-o.sw_rise_ns: not stated in TPS61088RHLR.pdf: no switch rise-time row in its tables (35 pages); section 11.1 only says the switch rise and fall times are very fast
sw_not_stated-o.sw_fall_ns: not stated in TPS61088RHLR.pdf: no switch fall-time row in its tables (35 pages)
sw_not_stated-o.sw_coss_pf: not stated in TPS61088RHLR.pdf: no switch-pin or C_oss capacitance row in its tables (35 pages)

sw_source-o.table-s: 6.1 Absolute Maximum Ratings (row VIN, SW, FSW, VOUT: -0.3 V to 14.5 V; no transient row). Entered by hand: the datasheet on file is TI's Chinese edition (ZHCSDT5), which procurement supplies does not read

vref_source-o.table-s: 6.5 Electrical Characteristics, OUTPUT: VREF reference voltage at the FB pin, PWM mode 1.186/1.204/1.222 V, PFM mode 1.212 V typ

cap_source-o.table-s: 6.3 Recommended Operating Conditions: CO output capacitance, effective value 6.8 / 47 / 1000 uF (min/nom/max); CI input capacitance, effective value 10 uF (single figure, column not resolvable from the text layer)

vcc_source-o.table-s: 6.5 Electrical Characteristics: VCC regulation 5.8 V typ (IVCC = 5 mA, VIN = 8 V); VCC_UVLO 2.1 V falling. Pin 1 VCC is the internal LDO OUTPUT (Table 5-1 p3: 'A ceramic capacitor of more than 1.0 uF is required'), not a supply input

specs-o.loop_crossover_max_rule-s: fc no higher than the lower of fSW/10 or fRHPZ/5, fRHPZ = RO(1-D)^2/(2 pi L) (8.2.2.8 Loop Stability, p18-19, Equations 16 and 18); externally compensated (R5/C5/C8 on COMP), so the crossover is a design choice, not a device figure

not_stated-o.loop_crossover_khz: not stated: externally compensated, crossover chosen by the designer (p19 rule only)
not_stated-o.load_regulation_mv_per_a: not stated: no load-regulation row or curve in ZHCSDP8D
not_stated-o.iout_max_ma: not stated as a device rating: only the 10 A switch current (p1) and the 3 A rating of the 3.3 V to 9 V design example (Table 8-1 p14); the record's iout_max_ma 3000 is the design-example figure
